sources.title: How to Use Runable: The Complete 2026 Guidewhat
sources.snippet: What Is Runable? Runable is a general-purpose AI agent: you describe an outcome in plain language, and it executes the whole job, from research to build to deployment, inside its own sandbox. It is a different category from a chatbot, which answers questions but leaves the doing to you. That distinction matters for how you use it.

sources.title: Runable raises $21M Series A at $65M valuation on AI agent growth pivot
sources.snippet: Indian startup Runable closed a $21 million Series A at a $65 million post-money valuation, co-led by Susquehanna Venture Capital and Nexus Venture Partners, as it pivots from scraping infrastructure toward AI agents that help small businesses grow rather than merely build.
